commands.command: PYTHONPATH=src python -m epe.cli --format json graph build
PYTHONPATH=src python -m epe.cli --format json policy validate
PYTHONPATH=src python -m epe.cli --format json architecture validate

change: trace_path treats malformed origin, missing/non-finite confidence, boolean confidence, and confidence other than exactly 1.0 as candidate metadata instead of raising or claiming a determined path.
limitations: Path selection still returns one deterministic shortest path; complete alternative provenance remains available through graph_neighbors.
A candidate classification is a conservative transport fact, not an independent proof of impact or dependency completeness.
